Step Range: 2-18

Evidence: Steps 2-3 show initial failed search; Steps 4-18 show iterative searches and successful confirmation of the 1930 release year for "The First Seven Years".

The Subtask Name: Data Gathering for Cinesound Varieties
Step Range: 19-20
The Oracle: The WebSurfer searches for "Cinesound Varieties" release date, encountering conflicting years (1929 vs 1934), and identifies 1934 as the primary release year supported by Wikipedia and archival sources.
Evidence: Steps 19-20 show the WebSurfer executing searches for "Cinesound Varieties" and extracting the 1934 release year from multiple sources.

The Subtask Name: Final Comparison and Conclusion
Step Range: 21-21
The Oracle: The Planner synthesizes the gathered data (The First Seven Years: 1930; Cinesound Varieties: 1934) and determines that Cinesound Varieties was released more recently.
Evidence: Step 21 shows the Planner analyzing the final data points and preparing the conclusion based on the comparison of 1930 and 1934.
